raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The v2 card collector emits txn_ts in UTC while legacy emits America/Chicago local time, and silver_transactions stores both as if they were local. Each v2 row is therefore shifted about 6 hours forward, which pushes evening transactions into 00:00-06:00 of the next day and creates the 2026-01-19 volume spike. Converting v2 timestamps from UTC to America/Chicago before deriving txn_date fixes silver and, through it, the gold tables.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST((CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED');"}}
